sections.name: File setup, Reference
sections.title: Imports and reference type
sections.what: Loads the React hooks and job type, and defines what one document reference looks like: an ID, a path and an archive chain.

sections.name: PackageSummary
sections.title: Package summary shape
sections.what: Describes the inventory counts, file fingerprint, extraction totals, failure list and per-document details the panel expects from the server.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives the panel a clear expected shape of the server's answer.
sections.watch_out: The fields are marked optional, so missing data may appear as blank rather than as an error.

sections.what: Shows the package summary as counts, document outcomes and failure messages for the job.

sections.watch_out: Only the first two sections were visible, so the loading and error handling are not reviewed here.

summary: A panel that summarises the uploaded schedule package, showing what was inventoried, what was extracted, and any failures.
purpose: Lets the user see what the system read from the upload and whether any document failed.
why: Likely reason: supports checking and audit of which source documents were used.
how: Defines the shape of the package summary, including inventory counts, extraction results, and per-document outcome and references. The panel component then takes the job state and shows these details.
inputs: The job state, which carries the package details from the server.
outputs: A report on the page with counts, document outcomes and any error messages.
risks: Depends on exact field names from the server, so a renamed field would show empty values without an error. Only 2 of 3 sections were visible.
debug: If the report is blank, check the job state and whether the package is ready. Compare the field names here with the server's response.
